name: paid_flag
definition: 1 if sum of GARE VALOR_RECEITA for the certificate is > 0 with DATA_ARRECADACAO_GARE in [2016-01-01, 2026-01-01); else 0

name: origin
definition: declared if TIPO_DEBITO = ICMS Declarado; assessed if TIPO_DEBITO like ICMS Autua%

name: cohort
definition: enrolment year; thin or separating years merged (e.g. <=1978); reference chosen in prepare_population

name: section
definition: CNAE section at establishment match; rare sections and O/T merged into other when unstable

name: porte_pequena
source: this module; alternative coding suggested in review

name: firm_age_missing
definition: 1 if opening date missing or out of range

name: n_cdas_firm
definition: count of certificates of the same eight-digit root in the estimation frame
how_measured: groupby root size after load; root not written
source: this module on the Mac run

name: situacao_especial
definition: RFB situacao_especial when present (e.g. recuperação judicial token); availability partial
how_measured: enrichment column; not loaded in avd_origin_models today

name: municipality
definition: municipio from RFB enrichment (IBGE/name). Used in the lab 4.5/4.7 municipal complement, not in avd_origin_models logit

name: has_request
definition: certificate has a plausible instalment request date

name: instalment_open
definition: request on/before as-of and no plausible break on/before as-of

name: guaranteed
definition: always False; no guarantee table in the extract
source: no guarantee table in the data; collectable share is understated

name: root
definition: eight-digit CNPJ root used only to cluster or demean; never written
